Chapter 282: Chapter 21 Dao Oath, Step Into The Seventh Rank After Two Hundred Years (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Chapter 282: Chapter 21 Dao Oath, Step into the Seventh Rank After Two Hundred Years (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

Mu Qingliu’s mouth twitched slightly.

Daring to negotiate terms with his own ancestor, Lin Yuan was indeed the first.

“Please speak, young friend.”

The Cangqing Immortal said nonchalantly.

A sacred oath was already established; any further requests were insignificant.

“I hope that if the Martial Tao Cultivation System can give birth to a Sixth Rank, they should also have the opportunity to ascend to the Spirit Realm via the Ascension Platform.”

...

Lin Yuan stated.

The Spirit Realm, far surpassing the Central Divine Continent, would allow cultivators of the Martial Arts Evolution System to go there and settle, which would greatly benefit the spread of Lin Yuan’s Martial Tao.

Of course.

Without Lin Yuan’s protection.

The spread of the Martial Arts Evolution System in the Spirit Realm might not go smoothly.

But this was just a casual move Lin Yuan had laid out; success or failure did not matter much.

Securing an opportunity for this world’s cultivators to ascend to the Spirit Realm was already a worthy achievement.

“No problem.”

The Cangqing Immortal nodded.

Allowing the spread of the Martial Tao Cultivation System, ascending through the Ascension Platform was naturally not difficult.

Subsequently.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

The Cangqing Immortal made another sacred oath.

…

After Lin Yuan left.

The smile on the Cangqing Immortal’s face faded.

“Ancestor…”

Mu Qingliu started to speak but hesitated.

The conversation between the ancestor and Jun Wuji had issues that even he could perceive.

The Cangqing Immortal was simply letting Jun Wuji take advantage of him.

“You don’t understand.”

The Cangqing Immortal glanced at Mu Qingliu, shook his head and said, “Such a genius, even in the Spirit Realm, could shine brilliantly. If he can approach me with requests now, after a thousand or ten thousand years, I wouldn’t even be able to beg him for that.”

The gaze of the Cangqing Immortal remained calm.

After all, for him, there was no significant loss, even if he let the Martial Tao spread, the Immortal Path still existed.

“The next leader of the Immortal Sect will be chosen from the direct descendants of this young friend.”

The Cangqing Immortal thought for a while, then added.

Usually, he did not concern himself with the selection of the leader for the Immortal Sect of the Central Divine Continent.

Because such matters barely caught his interest but now, involving Jun Wuji, he had to intervene.

“Yes.”

Mu Qingliu responded respectfully.

At this moment, he also felt the Cangqing Ancestor’s emphasis on Jun Wuji.

…

Having dispatched the Cangqing Immortal.

Mu Qingliu returned, with mixed feelings, to the highest hall on Immortal Mountain.

“You?”

Mu Qingliu immediately noticed Jun Wuji standing outside the grand hall.

“I wish to peruse the Taoist Immortal Scripture…”

Lin Yuan stated his purpose.

The Taoist Immoral Scripture contained crucial descriptions about the Dao Integration Stage, which Lin Yuan found quite interesting.

Mu Qingliu was silent for a while, considering the attitude of the Cangqing Immortal, and readily handed over the Taoist Immortal Scripture that only the successive leaders were qualified to cultivate.

…

Atop the Nine Heavens.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In his mind, numerous descriptions of the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’ emerged continuously.

[Your perception is contrary to the heavens, your comprehension of the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’ deepens your understanding of the essence of the Dao Integration Stage…]

…

[Your perception is contrary to the heavens, your comprehension of the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’ deepens your understanding of the essence of the Dao Integration Stage…]

…

[Your perception is contrary to the heavens, your comprehension of the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’ deepens your understanding of the essence of the Dao Integration Stage…]

…

“Dao Integration Stage…”

“Seventh Rank…”

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

Studying the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’ indeed was helpful for opening the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path for Lin Yuan.

“Currently, the beginning of the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path has twelve directions.”

“These twelve directions, possessing their own nature and advantages, yet I still find them somewhat lacking.”

Lin Yuan frowned slightly.

After mastering the ‘Taoist Immortal Scripture’, Lin Yuan once again opened up four new directions for the Seventh Rank Chapter, still seeing a discrepancy with what he envisioned for the Seventh Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Should I wait a bit longer?”

“Or should I break into the Seventh Rank first and see.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and decided to choose the latter.

If he were in the Main World, he would have definitely planned to take things slow and continue to comprehend.

After all, the body in the Main World was his original, and after the Sixth Rank, once a wrong path was taken, it was hard to turn back, especially between the Sixth and Seventh Ranks which were crucial stages.

But in world traversal… even if he took the wrong path, it would not affect Lin Yuan’s original body.

After the Sixth Rank, it is very hard to turn back because the Evolutionary Path being cultivated already affects the soul.

In such a case, neither switching to a well-copied body nor consuming rare spiritual objects to cleanse the body could be of any use.

Because the influence on the soul would not disappear,

As for cleansing the soul… The soul is extremely mysterious, who would dare to cleanse their own soul lightly?

Aren’t they afraid of an irreversible doom?

However, these limitations could not constrain the current Lin Yuan.

Every time he traversed worlds, it was a Descent of Consciousness.

What is consciousness? It is an essence even more core than the soul.

Be it the Sixth Rank or the Seventh Rank, or even the Eighth Rank, they all involve the soul, but it’s hard for them to affect consciousness.

…

Lin Yuan was clearly dissatisfied with all twelve directions of the Seventh Rank Chapter, yet he still chose one to forcefully break through.

Not only because it wouldn’t affect his original body.

But also because there is a qualitative difference between the Sixth and Seventh Ranks.

Even a superficial Seventh Rank is still Seventh Rank, being in this realm, everything he sees, thinks, knows, and contemplates, surpasses that of the Sixth Rank.

If Lin Yuan steps into the Seventh Rank, he can completely look down from a high place and re-comprehend the progress from the Sixth Rank Chapter to the Seventh Rank Chapter in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

In the Main World, those evolution scholars who possess the power of the Eighth or even Ninth Rank, given such a height, it isn’t difficult to establish a tremendously potential Third, Fourth, and Fifth Rank Evolutionary Path.

…

Time slowly passed.

A hundred years flickered by.

Since Lin Yuan and the Daode Immortal Sect’s Ancestral Master of the Spirit Realm, Cangqing Immortal, reached an agreement.

The White Jade Pavilion has seen unprecedented development and even began mutually beneficial cooperation with the Daode Immortal Sect.

The Immortal Sect Leader Mu Qingliu even personally came to Baiyu Island to discuss many matters with Jun Dongjin and Mu Lian’er.

Mu Qingliu expressed the intention to invite Jun Dongjin to become the next Sect Leader of the Immortal Sect.

As for this, Jun Dongjin had little interest. Since his century-long stay at Vast Cliff Mountain, Jun Dongjin had seen through the so-called struggle for power. He liked the environment of Baiyu Island, so he declined Mu Qingliu’s invitation.

Finally, through final discussions, Jun Xiaoyao was appointed the next Sect Leader of the Immortal Sect.

Jun Xiaoyao is Jun Wuji’s older brother, closely related by blood, meeting the requirements that Cangqing Immortal had for the next generation’s Sect Leader of the Immortal Sect.

…

In the far west.

This place was more remote than the Barbarian Wilderness, with almost no spiritual energy, hence it was rarely visited by people, and even vitality-resilient demonic beasts rarely settled in this area.

Now.

On a large rock.

A figure indeed lay there.

“Seventh Rank.”

“Did not expect there to be world suppression?”

Lin Yuan felt somewhat helpless in his heart. Decades ago, he had been very close to the Seventh Rank, but when he tried to break through, he could indeed feel the suppression from nature.

“No wonder hundreds of thousands of years ago, there were many great beings who surpassed the Void Refinement Limit, but there wasn’t a single one in the Dao Integration Stage.”

“Until the Ascension Platform appeared, those great beings who ascended to the Spirit Realm gradually stepped into the Dao Integration Stage…”

Lin Yuan sighed.

“What to do.”

“I don’t want to enter the Spirit Realm through the Ascension Platform…”

Lin Yuan fell deep in thought.

Not knowing what lay on the other side of the Ascension Platform, Lin Yuan did not want to take risks with his life.

Besides.

Even if he wanted to enter the Spirit Realm.

Lin Yuan would use the Door to the Myriad Realms, entering the Spirit Realm through a Descent of Consciousness.

This method would allow perfect integration into the Spirit Realm without being deliberately targeted.

“The so-called world suppression is not absolutely insurmountable to break through to the Seventh Rank.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Over the past decades, he had been trying to figure out a method to evade world suppression, and now he had some clues.

“Take it slow.”

“There’s still more than a hundred years left.”

Lin Yuan wasn’t in a hurry. As long as he broke through to the Seventh Rank within the time limit of his stay, it would be sufficient.

…

Time slowly passed.

A hundred years went by once again.

At the edge of the East Sea, the area was still an endless ocean.

In theory, no one should come here, after all, there is little spiritual energy, and cultivators wouldn’t even glance at it.

And ordinary people? They couldn’t even reach this place.

Above the ocean, tsunamis, giant beasts, and many other threats are simply insurmountable for ordinary people.

But at this moment

A small boat was drifting on the calm sea surface.

Hum!

An inexplicable energy, from within the boat, began to spread to all directions.
